subject: Music Production
title: The Missing Fundamental
description: A 60-second lesson on The Missing Fundamental.

hook.text: Play the harmonics of a bass note without the bass itself, and your brain still hears the bass.

buildup.text: This happens because the brain reconstructs the fundamental frequency from its overtone pattern.

discovery.text: The missing fundamental trick lets small speakers appear to produce deep bass they cannot physically play.

twist.text: Phone speakers are too tiny for real bass, but clever processing makes you think you hear it.

climax.text: Producers use harmonic enhancement to ensure bass translates even on small playback devices.

punchline.text: Your brain fills in bass that isn't really there.

quiz.question: How do phone speakers seem to produce deep bass?
options: The brain reconstructs bass from its overtones
They compress the bass into higher frequencies
